note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Ba'athist Syria under President Hafez al-Assad), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: the armed forces and security services around the presidency, the Ba'ath Party apparatus, state-linked business and the rural base of the party.
